Preparation & Dosage ⬇️ 
Get   DRIED PAPAYA   LEAVES       in  Bulk, air-dry in a shade away from direct sunlight (in a shade / balcony) then blend bulk to POWDER when 100% dehydrated (Takes a week or More)

Inside half litre of already boiled water (or quantity of water you can consume at a go),  STEEP / SOAK  The measurement / dosage  of  DRIED PAPAYA  LEAVES POWDER  associated with the illness you're treating above.  COVER  it and allow infuse for  20 - 30   minutes or until warm enough to drink. 

DO NOT COOK IT!
Filter / Sieve & drink whole liquid extract.
Do this DAILY for the specified number of times & timeframe associated with the illness you intend to treat. 

For FRESH LEAVES, STEEP  3 - 5  BIG  LEAVES (or a handful of the Leaves)  IN BOILED WATER (SAME PROCESS) 

WHEN TO TAKE: 1 HOUR   BEFORE OR AFTER FOOD

text:
This week, the UN Inter-Agency Task Force on NCDs @un_ncd held its 27th meeting at @WHO headquarters in Geneva, with agencies around the table and online.

What struck me again is how much of preventing #NCDs noncommunicable diseases happens outside the health sector: in tax policy, farming, food systems, city planning, clean air and workplace practices. No single agency holds all of these levers, which is why the @FCTCofficial, @UNDP,  @UNHABITAT, @UN_Nutrition, @UNICEF, WHO and many others work on them together.

Part one of my two videos from the meeting focuses on prevention 👇 

Part two, on care, resources and countries, comes next.
